label: PROPER_PART_EXTENSIONALITY_1: unrestricted strict-part identity
definition: For any two objects x and y, SameProperParts x y implies x=y. In particular objects with no strict parts have the same empty lower cone. This is a candidate identity principle, not a theorem of PartialOrder or of classical full fusion. Depends on the SameProperParts definition f3379a14-41d3-48b6-a91e-4b694d136c0a.
